name: JUICE
note: Launched 2023 · ESA's explorer bound for Jupiter's icy moons (arrives 2031)

name: Europa Clipper
note: Launched 2024 · en route to Jupiter to study the ocean moon Europa (arrives 2030)

name: New Horizons
note: Launched 2006 · flew past Pluto (2015) & Arrokoth (2019) · now in the Kuiper belt

name: Voyager 1
note: Launched 1977 · now in interstellar space · humanity's most distant object

name: Voyager 2
note: Launched 1977 · only spacecraft to visit Uranus & Neptune · now interstellar

name: Pioneer 10
note: Launched 1972 · first through the asteroid belt & past Jupiter · now silent

name: Pioneer 11
note: Launched 1973 · first to visit Saturn · now silent, heading toward Sagittarius

name: Parker Solar Probe
note: Launched 2018 · flying through the Sun's corona — the fastest human object

name: James Webb Space Telescope
note: Launched 2021 · orbiting the L2 point, 1.5M km from Earth — the great eye of our age

name: Juno
note: Launched 2011 · orbiting Jupiter since 2016, mapping its storms and deep interior
